packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.name: Workspace package
packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.description: Marks the owner's workspace code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.name: Workspace client
packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.description: The main server's way of talking to the workspace supervisor, scrubbing any secret that appears in command output or files before it is passed on.

packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.name: Name lookups
packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.description: The small amount of address-lookup handling the network filter needs to read a request and answer or forward it.

packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.name: What the workspace may reach
packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.description: Builds the rules and name filter for which outside places the workspace is allowed to connect to.

packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.name: Network guard
packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.description: Runs as the workspace's network gatekeeper: it applies the connection rules and checks each lookup so the workspace can only reach allowed places.

packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.name: Connection relay
packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.description: Every connection leaving the workspace is routed through here, which reads where it is headed and allows or blocks it.

packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.name: Workspace supervisor
packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.description: The single trusted process inside the owner's workspace that runs commands, reads and writes files, and starts and stops the workspace's tasks, under strict limits.

packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.name: Per-agent users
packages/workspace/src/lonora_workspace/.description: Gives each agent its own separate account inside the workspace, kept stable even when the workspace is rebuilt.

GET /v1/health.name: Workspace health
GET /v1/health.description: Reports the workspace supervisor's limits and how much disk is free; an internal check inside the workspace, not reached from the apps.

POST /v1/run.name: Run a command
POST /v1/run.description: Runs a command inside the owner's workspace, in the foreground or background, under its time and resource limits; an internal request inside the workspace, reached over its local socket rather than the public server.

POST /v1/files/read.name: Read a workspace file
POST /v1/files/read.description: Reads a file inside the owner's workspace; an internal request reached over the workspace's local socket.

POST /v1/files/write.name: Write a workspace file
POST /v1/files/write.description: Writes a file inside the owner's workspace; an internal request reached over the workspace's local socket.

GET /v1/processes.name: List workspace tasks
GET /v1/processes.description: Lists every task running in the owner's workspace; an internal request reached over the workspace's local socket.

POST /v1/processes/stop.name: Stop a workspace task
POST /v1/processes/stop.description: Stops one task in the owner's workspace; an internal request reached over the workspace's local socket.

POST /v1/processes/stop-all.name: Stop all workspace tasks
POST /v1/processes/stop-all.description: Stops every task belonging to an agent in the owner's workspace; an internal request reached over the workspace's local socket.
